# Jig

Jig is a local, secure host for admitted FLOW packages.

- Landing page: https://jig.md/
- Direct-alpha guide: https://jig.md/guide/
- Working with files (source candidate): https://jig.md/guide/files
- Proposal workshop (source candidate): https://jig.md/guide/proposal-workshop
- Tested patch (source candidate): https://jig.md/guide/tested-patch
- Workflow-design guide: https://jig.md/guide/workflow-design
- Non-normative use cases: https://jig.md/use-cases
- Candidate orchestration patterns: https://jig.md/orchestration-patterns
- Project Authoring SDK: https://jig.md/spec/project-sdk
- Project and execution policy: https://jig.md/spec/project-policy
- Agent Run capability: https://jig.md/spec/agent-run
- Agent Run descriptor: https://jig.md/contracts/agent-run.capability.json
- Security boundary: https://github.com/jiggy/jig/blob/main/SECURITY.md
- Source and installation: https://github.com/jiggy/jig
- FLOW specifications: https://flow.jig.md/
